Docker · {{ t('A prepared stack', '预置完整环境') }}

{{ t('The image includes Megatron, SGLang and slime’s patches. On your Linux x86_64 GPU host, have Git, Docker and the NVIDIA driver ready, with', '镜像已包含 Megatron、SGLang 和 slime 所需补丁。Linux x86_64 GPU 主机需准备 Git、Docker、NVIDIA 驱动，并配置好') }} NVIDIA Container Toolkit ↗.

1 / {{ t('On the host', '在宿主机上') }}
SLIME_IMAGE=slimerl/slime:latest-cu129
docker pull "$SLIME_IMAGE"
git clone https://github.com/THUDM/slime.git
cd slime
mkdir -p ../slime-data
docker run --rm -it --gpus all --ipc=host \
  --shm-size=16g --ulimit memlock=-1 --ulimit stack=67108864 \
  -v "$PWD:/root/slime" -v "$PWD/../slime-data:/data" \
  -w /root/slime "$SLIME_IMAGE" /bin/bash
2 / {{ t('Inside the container', '进入容器后') }}
pip install -e . --no-deps
python -c "import slime, sglang, megatron.core; import torch; print('GPUs:', torch.cuda.device_count())"

{{ t('Your checkout stays on the host. Models, data and checkpoints under /data persist in the sibling slime-data directory after the container exits. The builder uses /data by default.', '代码保留在宿主机。容器内 /data 下的模型、数据和 checkpoint 存在旁边的 slime-data 目录，退出容器后仍保留；下方配置器默认使用 /data。') }}

Conda · {{ t('Build with micromamba', '使用 micromamba 构建') }}

{{ t('The repository’s build_conda.sh creates a slime environment with Python 3.12, CUDA 12.9, Megatron, SGLang and the matching patches. It installs micromamba and compiles native dependencies.', '仓库的 build_conda.sh 会创建 slime 环境，安装 Python 3.12、CUDA 12.9、Megatron、SGLang 及配套补丁。脚本会安装 micromamba，并编译原生依赖。') }}

{{ t('Use a Linux x86_64 NVIDIA machine with Bash, Git, curl, patch, a C/C++ toolchain and a compatible GPU driver. The current script expects write access to /root. For B200/B300, use the CUDA 13 Docker image above.', '适用于 Linux x86_64 NVIDIA 环境，需要 Bash、Git、curl、patch、C/C++ 编译工具及兼容驱动。当前脚本需要 /root 写权限；B200/B300 请使用上面的 CUDA 13 Docker 镜像。') }}

1 / {{ t('Clone & build', '克隆并构建') }}
git clone https://github.com/THUDM/slime.git
cd slime
BASE_DIR=/root SHELL=/bin/bash bash build_conda.sh
2 / {{ t('Activate in your Bash shell', '在当前 Bash 中激活') }}
source ~/.bashrc
micromamba activate slime
export CUDA_HOME="$CONDA_PREFIX"
python -c "import slime, sglang, megatron.core; import torch; print('GPUs:', torch.cuda.device_count())"

{{ t('After the build finishes, activate the environment in each new shell. In the builder’s Files step, choose writable model, data and output paths; Megatron is at /root/Megatron-LM.', '构建完成后，在每个新终端中激活环境。在配置器「文件」步骤填写可写的模型、数据及输出路径；Megatron 位于 /root/Megatron-LM。') }} {{ t('Build script ↗', '查看构建脚本 ↗') }}
